author: Y Combinator
description:
Hop Aero is building rockets that can deliver cargo anywhere on Earth in minutes.

They’re starting with military logistics and other time-sensitive payloads, including temperature-controlled materials with short shelf lives, where getting something there much faster can materially change the outcome.

They’ve already built and successfully hot-fired a new rocket engine, and signed $1.37B in commercial LOIs.
title: Rocket cargo delivery anywhere on Earth in minutes
